skills.name: rust-widgets-maintainer
skills.description: Maintain, extend and audit the rust-widgets Rust GUI library and everything beside it. Use when changing controls, layouts, rendering, platform backends, the code editor, capability metadata, JSON layout loading, the rust-widgets-cli `rwui` tool (check, json2rust, fmt, create), the suites/font/icon/mobile-services crates, the demo applications, this DSH plugin, or running the repository's validation gates.
skills.whenToUse: Load when working inside the rust-widgets repository on a coding, review, or validation task, including tasks that touch `crates/`, `demo/`, `examples/`, or `dsh-plugin/`.
